# Hamza Shaikh (@HamzaShaikhAI)

> Independent software developer and open-source builder creating Windows systems software (KeplerBridge D3D12-to-D3D11 compatibility layer for NVIDIA GeForce GT 740 and Kepler GPUs), local-first AI agent orchestration (AgentForge), autonomous video & motion graphics engines for AI agents (Remotion-For-Antigravity), and developer tooling.

## Primary Pages & Dedicated Guides

- [Portfolio Home](https://hamzashaikhai.com/): Overview of Hamza Shaikh (@HamzaShaikhAI), Interactive 3D Systems Lab, audience workflows, flagship repositories, technical matrix, and FAQ.
- [Android AI Optimizer (MCP &amp; ADB)](https://hamzashaikhai.com/android-ai-optimizer/): Zero-dependency Python 3.10+ MCP server (10 scoped tools, zero raw shell access) &amp; 5-stage ADB optimizer for non-rooted Android phones with UAD-NG validation and 1-click rollback (+525.7 MB RAM on Oppo A57).
- [KeplerBridge GT 740 / DirectX 12 Guide](https://hamzashaikhai.com/keplerbridge/): Dedicated installation guide, GPU support matrix (GT 740 / GK107, GTX 750–780, GTX TITAN), shader cache benchmarks (~1.12 ms cold to ~0.03 ms warm load), and DX12 game compatibility notes.
- [AgentForge Platform](https://hamzashaikhai.com/agentforge/): Local-first Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration platform and safety harness for autonomous AI coding agents, featuring 5-tier permission gates, capability truth engine, and Windows DPAPI credential isolation. Includes official [Privacy Policy](https://hamzashaikhai.com/agentforge/privacy/) (Google API Services User Data Policy compliance) and [Terms of Service](https://hamzashaikhai.com/agentforge/terms/).
- [Engineering Blog](https://hamzashaikhai.com/blog/): Original architectural notes and technical deep dives on [AWS WAF MCP Guardrails vs. Host-Side Redaction Bypasses in AgentForge](https://hamzashaikhai.github.io/blog/2026-11-26-mcp-waf-guardrails-cve-redaction-agentforge/), [MCP at Two Years: Tasks, Elicitation, Skills &amp; AgentForge Safety Gates](https://hamzashaikhai.github.io/blog/2026-11-25-mcp-two-years-tasks-elicitation-agentforge/), [MCP Tool Explosion &amp; Code Execution in AgentForge](https://hamzashaikhai.com/blog/2026-11-19-mcp-code-execution-agentforge-context-efficiency/), [Notion Block Engine AST &amp; LLM Context](https://hamzashaikhai.com/blog/2026-11-18-notion-block-engine-ast-markdown-llm-context/), [How Remotion Works: Programmatic Video Engine Explained](https://hamzashaikhai.com/blog/2026-11-18-remotion-programmatic-video-engine-explained/), [Evaluating Agent Autonomy: AWS UAEF &amp; AgentForge](https://hamzashaikhai.com/blog/2026-11-15-agent-evaluation-uaef-agentforge-truth-engine/), [Remotion For Antigravity v2.4.0 Release](https://hamzashaikhai.com/blog/remotion-for-antigravity-v2-stable-release/), [DirectX 12 Agility SDK 1.620 &amp; Enhanced Barriers](https://hamzashaikhai.com/blog/2026-11-14-dx12-agility-sdk-enhanced-barriers-keplerbridge/), [Stateless MCP Agent Security](https://hamzashaikhai.com/blog/2026-11-13-stateless-mcp-agent-security/), [Gemini 4 Hydrogen Sub-Millisecond Edge Agents](https://hamzashaikhai.com/blog/gemini-4-hydrogen-sub-millisecond-edge-agents/), [Gemini 4 Carbon Agent Swarms](https://hamzashaikhai.com/blog/gemini-4-carbon-agent-swarms/), [KeplerBridge DXIL-to-DXBC translation](https://hamzashaikhai.com/blog/run-dx12-on-gt740-keplerbridge/) and [AgentForge MCP approval gates](https://hamzashaikhai.com/blog/agentforge-mcp-approval-gates/).
- [Full Technical Profile](https://hamzashaikhai.com/llms-full.txt): Extended markdown knowledge base optimized for LLM context retrieval.

## Featured Open-Source Repositories

- [KeplerBridge](https://github.com/HamzaShaikhAI/KeplerBridge): Open-source C++20 Direct3D 12-to-Direct3D 11 (`d3d12.dll` proxy) compatibility layer enabling DirectX 12 workloads on legacy NVIDIA Kepler GPUs (GeForce GT 740, GTX 750, GTX 760, GTX 770, GTX 780, GTX TITAN / GK107, GK104, GK208, Feature Level 11_0) via cleanroom LLVM 3.7 Shader Model 6.0 DXIL-to-SM 5.0 DXBC lowering (`v0.5.0-rc1`, Windows x64, MIT).
- [AgentForge](https://github.com/HamzaShaikhAI/AgentForge): Local-first TypeScript 5.6 and Node.js (>=20) AI agent integration and workflow platform for Google Antigravity with MCP bridges, Manager UI dashboard, fine-grained permission gates, human approval checkpoints, and credential isolation (MIT).
- [Android AI Optimizer](https://github.com/HamzaShaikhAI/android-ai-optimizer): Zero-dependency Python 3.10+ MCP stdio server &amp; 5-stage non-root ADB optimizer for Google Antigravity with live UAD-NG dependency validation, bootloop blocklist, and 1-click rollback (MIT).
- [Remotion-For-Antigravity](https://github.com/HamzaShaikhAI/Remotion-For-Antigravity): Autonomous motion graphics, video editing & multimedia engine for Google Antigravity 2.0 AI agents. Programmatic React video generation, deterministic spring physics, bundled zero-config FFmpeg, lossless trimming & EBU R128 loudness normalization (`rea` CLI, MIT).
- [Notion Block Engine](https://github.com/HamzaShaikhAI/notion-block-engine): Zero-dependency TypeScript 5.0+ (<15 KB) engine for bidirectional conversion and dirty clipboard HTML sanitization (Google Docs, MS Word) between HTML, GFM Markdown, and Notion-style Block ASTs (MIT).
- [VYDRIX](https://github.com/HamzaShaikhAI/VYDRIX): Archived C#/.NET Windows cloud-backed virtual storage experiment using WinFsp, preserved with a public technical post-mortem.

## Key Verified Facts

- Name: Hamza Shaikh (`@HamzaShaikhAI`)
- Collaboration Scope: Worldwide / Global Remote
- Primary Languages: C++20, TypeScript, Python, JavaScript, Dart, C#
- KeplerBridge Target Hardware: NVIDIA GeForce GT 740 (`GK107`), GTX 750, GTX 760, GTX 770, GTX 780, GTX TITAN (`GK104`, `GK208`, `D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL_11_0` / `0xB000`)
- KeplerBridge Drop-In Usage: Place 64-bit `d3d12.dll` + `kepler_bridge.ini` beside the game `.exe`; zero Windows system-file or driver modifications required.
